item.title: So, We Moved In
item.description:
After years of building, many Bunnings trips and an unreasonable amount of sanding, we finally moved into the Miette in February. It is now October. So, what have we been doing for the last eight months?

Well, apparently the building never really stops.

Table Of Contents
  • Making the Tiny Actually Liveable
  • Electricity
  • Cosmetics
  • Greywater
  • A Few Learnings: The Tiny House Is Tiny
  • Off on Another Adventure

Making the Tiny Actually Liveable

In February, we’ve bundled all of Erny’s gear inside, but with not much storage so everything was pretty much everywhere. Over time though, inside, Lys has become something of a shelf master, installing floating shelves made from some very pretty blackbutt and a gorgeous eucalyptus offcut we picked up from a gentleman near Mollymook. Erny painstakingly installed the plywood cupboards and Lys diligently oiled them, and somehow we have even managed to squeeze in hanging space. Luxury. Our beautiful curved Tasmanian blackwood benchtops runs along both sides of the house and our $10 Corian sink has finally been installed, plumbed and christened (with running hot water!).
